content: RECALL——反事实知识的构造：作者区分常识知识与科学知识两个领域，并通过编辑答案文本、编辑非答案文本两种方式注入错误。答案编辑中，EventKG 的答案被 ChatGPT 替换为无关值，UJ 的答案文本则通过改变部分词语含义引入反事实信息；非答案编辑是在不包含答案的部分加入事实错误，同时保留该问题答案的正确性。因此，QA-A 与 QA-NA 分别对应“答案相关信息被改错”与“周边信息有错但答案仍正确”，不是同一种干扰条件。

sources.title: RECALL: A Benchmark for LLMs Robustness against External Counterfactual Knowledge
sources.content:
For a comprehensive evaluation, we decided to
assess models’ robustness against counterfactual
knowledge in two different domains: common
sense knowledge and scientific knowledge.

sources.title: RECALL: A Benchmark for LLMs Robustness against External Counterfactual Knowledge
sources.content:
Editing Answer Texts
For EventKG, we ask
ChatGPT to replace the answer with an unrelated
value. For UJ, we demand ChatGPT to change the
meanings of some words in the answer texts. In this
way, the answer-relevant part of the text is directly
affected and carries counterfactual information.

4) Edit Non-answer Texts
For each paragraph
generated in Step 1, we add counterfactual informa-
tion to the part without answers, so that the whole
text contains factual errors but does not affect the
correctness of the answer to the query.
